POST /api/v1/memos

The `CreateMemo` RPC in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` is annotated with `google.api.http` as `post: "/api/v1/memos"`. The generated REST gateway in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go` registers that same mapping.
